paragraphSteps.excerpt: OSIRIS-REx returned material from asteroid Bennu on September 24, 2023. The mission required at least 60 grams.
That requirement had already been exceeded before the sampling head was completely opened. A final pour then added 51.2 grams.
The completed inventory amounted to 121.6 grams, establishing the final total in relation to the 60-gram minimum.
